source.text: כָּל־הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: All the commandment which I [am] commanding you today you shall take care to do, so that you may live and multiply and go in and take possession of the land which swore Yahweh to your fathers.

en.L: All the commandment that I am commanding you today you shall take care to do, so that you may live and increase and go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} swore to your fathers.
en.B: Be careful to carry out every commandment that I am giving you today, so that you may live and grow in number, and go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised on oath to your ancestors.
en.R: Be careful to obey every command I am giving you today. Then you will live and become many. You will go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised your ancestors with an oath.

es.L: Todo el mandamiento que yo te mando hoy {{plural_you:cuidarán|cuidaréis}} de cumplirlo, para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} y {{plural_you:se multipliquen|os multipliquéis}} y {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} y {{plural_you:tomen|toméis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juró a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} cuidado en cumplir todo mandamiento que hoy te doy, para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} y {{plural_you:crezcan|crezcáis}} en número, y {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} y {{plural_you:tomen|toméis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} prometió con juramento a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado de obedecer cada mandamiento que hoy te doy. Así {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} y {{plural_you:llegarán|llegaréis}} a ser muchos. {{plural_you:Entrarán|Entraréis}} y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} prometió con juramento a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.

fr.L: Tout le commandement que je te commande aujourd’hui, vous veillerez à le pratiquer, afin que vous viviez, que vous vous multipliiez, et que vous entriez et preniez possession du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré à vos pères.
fr.B: Veillez à mettre en pratique chaque commandement que je te donne aujourd’hui, afin que vous viviez et deveniez nombreux, et que vous entriez et preniez possession du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis par serment à vos ancêtres.
fr.R: Faites bien attention à obéir à chaque commandement que je te donne aujourd’hui. Alors vous vivrez et vous deviendrez nombreux. Vous entrerez dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis par serment à vos ancêtres, et vous en prendrez possession.

sw.L: Amri yote ninayokuamuru leo mtaangalia kuitenda, ili mpate kuishi na kuongezeka na kuingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaapia baba zenu.
sw.B: Angalieni kutekeleza kila amri ninayokupa leo, ili mpate kuishi na kuongezeka, na kuingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaahidi mababu zenu kwa kiapo.
sw.R: Kuweni waangalifu kutii kila amri ninayokupa leo. Ndipo mtaishi na kuwa wengi. Mtaingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaahidi mababu zenu kwa kiapo.

decisions.choice: all the commandment: the whole of what Moses commands, taken as one
decisions.reason: The noun is singular, "the commandment", but it gathers up the whole body of teaching Moses is giving, as in 5:31, 6:1 and 7:11. It is not one single rule.

decisions.choice: you (plural): the people addressed as many
decisions.reason: Moses speaks to Israel here as "you" plural; in verse 2 he turns to "you" singular, addressing the nation as one person, and in verses 19-20 back to the plural. The same people are meant throughout, and the switch does not change who is addressed.

decisions.choice: the land the LORD swore to your fathers: the promise made to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: God promised the land on oath to Israel's ancestors (Genesis 12:7; 15:18; 26:3; 50:24), and Deuteronomy keeps tying obedience to receiving that promise (6:18; 7:12-13).

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "fathers"; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors", the forefathers of the nation, not the hearers' own fathers.

decisions.choice: every commandment / every command
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the collective singular into "every", which keeps the sense of the whole without suggesting one particular rule. Literal keeps "all the commandment".

decisions.choice: "te mando" / "te doy" (singular), then plural forms for the rest of the verse; the chapter keeps "tú" for Israel until the plural returns in verses 19-20
decisions.reason: As in chapters 1 and 7, Spanish follows the Hebrew number of "you" at every level.

decisions.choice: "je te commande" / "je te donne" (singular), then "vous" for the rest of the verse; the chapter keeps "tu" for Israel until "vous" returns in verses 19-20
decisions.reason: As in chapters 1 and 7, French follows the Hebrew number of "you" at every level.

decisions.choice: "ninayokuamuru" / "ninayokupa" (singular), then plural forms for the rest of the verse; the chapter keeps the singular for Israel until the plural returns in verses 19-20
decisions.reason: As in chapters 1 and 7, Swahili follows the Hebrew number of "you" at every level.

source.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת־כָּל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹלִֽיכֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֜ לְנַסֹּֽתְךָ֗ לָדַ֜עַת אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖יו אִם־לֹֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall remember all the way which led you Yahweh your God this forty years in the wilderness, so as to humble you, to test you, to know what [was] in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

en.L: And you shall remember all the way that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God led you these forty years in the wilderness, in order to humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments or not.
en.B: Remember the whole journey on which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God led you these forty years in the wilderness. He did it to humble you and to test you, to know what was in your heart: would you keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments or not?
en.R: Remember how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God led you all the way through the wilderness for these forty years. He did this to make you humble and to test you. He wanted to show what was really in your heart, whether you would obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands or not.

es.L: Y te acordarás de todo el camino por el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha conducido estos cuarenta años en el desierto, para humillarte, para probarte, para saber lo que había en tu corazón, si guardarías {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos o no.
es.B: Acuérdate de todo el recorrido por el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te guió estos cuarenta años en el desierto. Lo hizo para humillarte y ponerte a prueba, para saber lo que había en tu corazón: ¿guardarías {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos o no?
es.R: Recuerda cómo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te guió por todo el camino a través del desierto durante estos cuarenta años. Lo hizo para que aprendieras a ser humilde y para ponerte a prueba. Quería mostrar lo que de verdad había en tu corazón, si obedecerías {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos o no.

fr.L: Et tu te souviendras de tout le chemin par lequel {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a conduit ces quarante années dans le désert, afin de t’humilier, de t’éprouver, de connaître ce qui était dans ton cœur, si tu garderais {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements ou non.
fr.B: Souviens-toi de toute la route sur laquelle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a conduit pendant ces quarante années dans le désert. Il l’a fait pour t’humilier et pour te mettre à l’épreuve, pour connaître ce qu’il y avait dans ton cœur : garderais-tu {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, oui ou non ?
fr.R: Rappelle-toi comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a conduit tout au long du chemin à travers le désert pendant ces quarante années. Il l’a fait pour te rendre humble et pour te mettre à l’épreuve. Il voulait montrer ce qu’il y avait vraiment dans ton cœur, si tu obéirais à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements ou non.

sw.L: Nawe utaikumbuka njia yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuongoza miaka hii arobaini nyikani, ili akunyenyekeze, akujaribu, ajue yaliyokuwa moyoni mwako, kama ungezishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} au la.
sw.B: Kumbuka safari yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuongoza miaka hii arobaini nyikani. Alifanya hivyo ili akunyenyekeze na kukujaribu, ajue yaliyokuwa moyoni mwako: je, ungezishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} au la?
sw.R: Kumbuka jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuongoza njia yote jangwani kwa miaka hii arobaini. Alifanya hivyo ili kukufanya mnyenyekevu na kukujaribu. Alitaka kuonyesha kilichokuwa kweli moyoni mwako, kama ungezitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} au la.

decisions.choice: humble you: bring you low through hardship
decisions.reason: The verb means to press down or afflict. Verse 3 says how: God let the people go hungry and depend on him for food. The hardship was meant to teach, not to destroy (verse 16).

decisions.choice: to test you, to know what was in your heart: testing brings into the open what is in a person
decisions.reason: God's testing makes plain, in what people actually do, what is in their heart, as when Abraham was tested (Genesis 22:1, 12) and in 13:4. It does not mean God lacked knowledge; it means the truth about Israel came out in the wilderness.

decisions.choice: his commandments (plural)
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text can be read as "his commandment" (singular), while the vowels and the reading tradition give "his commandments". The pinned data follows the read form. The sense is the same either way (compare "all the commandment" in verse 1). Reviewers should check this against the manuscript notes.

decisions.choice: all the way: the whole journey
decisions.reason: The "way" is the road the people traveled, the whole forty years of wandering from Egypt to the plains of Moab, not a manner of life.

decisions.choice: wanted to show
decisions.reason: Readable says "show" rather than "know" so that young readers do not think God was unaware of what was in their hearts (see m2).

source.text: וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ֒ וַיַּֽאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶתהַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־כָּל־מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he humbled you and let you hunger and fed you the manna which not you had known and not had known your fathers, so as to make you know that not on the bread by itself lives the human, but on all [that] goes out [from the] mouth of Yahweh lives the human.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbled you and made you hungry and fed you the manna, which you had not known and your fathers had not known, in order to make you know that not on bread alone does {{gender:the human being|man}} live, but on everything that goes out from the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does {{gender:the human being|man}} live.
en.B: He brought you low and let you go hungry, then gave you manna to eat, a food that neither you nor your ancestors had ever known. He did this to teach you that {{gender:people do|man does}} not live on bread alone, but {{gender:people live|man lives}} on everything that comes from the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He made you humble by letting you go hungry. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fed you with manna, a food you and your ancestors had never seen before. He wanted to teach you that {{gender:people do|man does}} not live on bread alone. {{gender:People live|Man lives}} by every word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} speaks.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te humilló y te hizo pasar hambre y te alimentó con el maná, que no conocías tú ni conocían tus padres, para hacerte saber que no de pan solamente vive {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}, sino que de todo lo que sale de la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vive {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}.
es.B: Te hizo pasar por la humillación y el hambre, y luego te dio a comer maná, un alimento que ni tú ni tus antepasados habían conocido. Lo hizo para enseñarte que {{gender:las personas no viven|el hombre no vive}} solo de pan, sino de todo lo que sale de la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Te hizo humilde dejándote pasar hambre. Luego {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te alimentó con maná, una comida que ni tú ni tus antepasados habían visto nunca. Quería enseñarte que {{gender:las personas no viven|el hombre no vive}} solo de pan. {{gender:Viven|Vive}} de cada palabra que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a humilié, et t’a fait avoir faim, et t’a nourri de la manne, que tu ne connaissais pas et que tes pères ne connaissaient pas, afin de te faire savoir que ce n’est pas de pain seul que vit {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}, mais que c’est de tout ce qui sort de la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que vit {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}.
fr.B: Il t’a abaissé et t’a laissé avoir faim, puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donné à manger la manne, une nourriture que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’aviez jamais connue. Il l’a fait pour t’apprendre que {{gender:les humains ne vivent|l’homme ne vit}} pas seulement de pain, mais {{gender:qu’ils vivent|qu’il vit}} de tout ce qui sort de la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il t’a rendu humble en te laissant avoir faim. Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a nourri de manne, une nourriture que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’aviez jamais vue. Il voulait t’apprendre que {{gender:les humains ne vivent|l’homme ne vit}} pas seulement de pain. {{gender:Ils vivent|Il vit}} de chaque parole que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye akakunyenyekeza, akakuacha uone njaa, akakulisha mana, ambayo wewe hukuijua wala baba zako hawakuijua, ili akujulishe kwamba mwanadamu haishi kwa mkate peke yake, bali kwa kila kitokacho katika kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mwanadamu huishi.
sw.B: Alikushusha chini na kukuacha uone njaa, kisha akakulisha mana, chakula ambacho wewe wala mababu zako hamkuwahi kukijua. Alifanya hivyo ili akufundishe kwamba watu hawaishi kwa mkate peke yake, bali wanaishi kwa kila kitu kinachotoka kinywani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Alikufanya mnyenyekevu kwa kukuacha uone njaa. Kisha akakulisha mana, chakula ambacho wewe na mababu zako hamkuwahi kukiona. Alitaka kukufundisha kwamba watu hawaishi kwa mkate peke yake. Wanaishi kwa kila neno analosema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: bread: ordinary food
decisions.reason: The word means bread and, more widely, food of any kind (as in verse 9). Here it stands for the food people grow and prepare for themselves, set against the manna God gave from heaven.

decisions.choice: everything that goes out from the mouth of the LORD: all that God says, his word and command
alternatives: every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD
decisions.reason: Hebrew says "all the going out of the mouth", that is, whatever God speaks. What came from his mouth in the wilderness was the command that gave manna each day (Exodus 16:4, 16) and the teaching that gave life (8:1; 30:15-20). The early Greek translation, which Jesus quotes, reads "every word that goes out through the mouth of God".

decisions.choice: quoted by Jesus in his testing in the wilderness (Matthew 4:4; Luke 4:4)
decisions.reason: Jesus, hungry after forty days in the wilderness, answers the tempter with this verse. As Israel was tested for forty years and fed by God, he trusts that life comes from what God says, not from bread made to order. Matthew quotes both halves of the saying; Luke quotes the first half.

decisions.choice: the human being: people in general
decisions.reason: The word is the general word for human beings, with the article as in a general statement: every person, man or woman.

decisions.choice: the manna: the food God gave daily in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Manna appeared on the ground each morning except the Sabbath for the forty years in the wilderness (Exodus 16:14-35; Numbers 11:7-9). Its name comes from the people's question "What is it?" (Exodus 16:15), and "which you had not known" stresses that it was new.

decisions.choice: the human being / people (default); man (traditional)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means all people, so the default wording is inclusive and the gender setting gives the traditional "man". Literal keeps the repeated subject at the end of each half, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: every word that the LORD speaks
decisions.reason: Readable explains "what goes out from the mouth" as the words God speaks, the sense given in m2.

decisions.choice: "mwanadamu" (L), "watu" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "mwanadamu" and "watu" already mean any human being; "mwanamume" would mean a male and change the sense, so Swahili has no traditional alternative to offer.

source.text: שִׂמְלָ֨תְךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Your clothing not wore out from on you, and your foot not swelled, this forty years.

en.L: Your clothing did not wear out from on you, and your foot did not swell, these forty years.
en.B: The clothes on your back did not wear out, and your feet did not swell, all these forty years.
en.R: During those forty years your clothes did not wear out, and your feet did not swell up from walking.

es.L: Tu ropa no se gastó sobre ti, y tu pie no se hinchó, estos cuarenta años.
es.B: La ropa que llevabas puesta no se desgastó, ni se te hincharon los pies, en todos estos cuarenta años.
es.R: Durante esos cuarenta años tu ropa no se desgastó, y tus pies no se hincharon de tanto caminar.

fr.L: Ton vêtement ne s’est pas usé sur toi, et ton pied n’a pas enflé, ces quarante années.
fr.B: Les vêtements que tu portais ne se sont pas usés, et tes pieds n’ont pas enflé, pendant toutes ces quarante années.
fr.R: Pendant ces quarante années, tes vêtements ne se sont pas usés, et tes pieds n’ont pas enflé à force de marcher.

sw.L: Nguo zako hazikuchakaa mwilini mwako, wala mguu wako haukuvimba, miaka hii arobaini.
sw.B: Nguo ulizovaa hazikuchakaa, wala miguu yako haikuvimba, miaka hii yote arobaini.
sw.R: Katika miaka hiyo arobaini nguo zako hazikuchakaa, wala miguu yako haikuvimba kwa kutembea.

decisions.choice: swell: become swollen and sore from walking
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here and in Nehemiah 9:21, which retells this verse. It describes feet swollen or blistered from long travel on foot.

decisions.choice: God's care kept the people's clothes and bodies through the journey
decisions.reason: The point is that God looked after them in every need, not only food. Moses says it again in 29:4, and Nehemiah 9:21 echoes it.

decisions.choice: from walking
decisions.reason: Readable adds the cause of the swelling, which the verb implies, so the picture is clear.

source.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם־לְבָבֶ֑ךָ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מְיַסְּרֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall know with your heart that as disciplines a man his son, Yahweh your God [is] disciplining you.

en.L: And you shall know with your heart that as a man disciplines his son, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is disciplining you.
en.B: So understand in your heart that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God disciplines you just as a father disciplines his son.
en.R: Understand this deep inside: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God corrects and trains you the way a father trains his son.

es.L: Y reconocerás en tu corazón que, como un hombre disciplina a su hijo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te disciplina.
es.B: Comprende, pues, en tu corazón que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te disciplina tal como un padre disciplina a su hijo.
es.R: Entiende esto en lo más profundo: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te corrige y te educa como un padre educa a su hijo.

fr.L: Et tu reconnaîtras dans ton cœur que, comme un homme corrige son fils, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te corrige.
fr.B: Comprends donc dans ton cœur que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te corrige comme un père corrige son fils.
fr.R: Comprends-le au fond de toi : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te corrige et te forme comme un père forme son fils.

sw.L: Nawe utajua moyoni mwako kwamba, kama mtu amwadibuvyo mwanawe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakuadibu.
sw.B: Basi tambua moyoni mwako kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakuadibu kama baba amwadibuvyo mwanawe.
sw.R: Elewa jambo hili ndani ya moyo wako: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakurekebisha na kukufundisha kama baba anavyomfundisha mwanawe.

decisions.choice: discipline: train and correct
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring up by instruction and correction, sometimes with punishment, as a parent does. In 4:36 and 11:2 it describes all that God taught Israel through what he did; Proverbs 3:11-12 uses it of the LORD correcting the one he loves.

decisions.choice: a man and his son: a father bringing up his child
decisions.reason: The picture is a father raising his son. It fits Israel's calling as God's son (Exodus 4:22; Deuteronomy 1:31; 14:1): the hard years were a father's training, not rejection.

decisions.choice: know in your heart: take it to heart, understand it fully
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will. To know something with the heart is to grasp it and let it shape how one lives.

decisions.choice: a father
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "a father" for "a man", since the man with his son is a father. Literal keeps "a man".

decisions.choice: corrects and trains
decisions.reason: Readable uses two verbs to give both sides of the Hebrew word, correction and training (m1).

source.text: וְשָׁ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶת־מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו וּלְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to fear him.

en.L: And you shall keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, to walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways and to fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, living by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways and holding {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in awe.
en.R: So obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Live the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants you to live, and honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with deep respect.

es.L: Y guardarás los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, para andar en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos y para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temas.
es.B: Guarda los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, viviendo según {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos y con reverencia hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Así que obedece los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Vive como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere que vivas, y ten un profundo respeto por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et tu garderas les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, pour marcher dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins et pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craindre.
fr.B: Garde les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, en suivant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins et en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} révérant.
fr.R: Obéis donc aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Vis comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut que tu vives, et honore-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec un profond respect.

sw.L: Nawe utazishika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kumcha.
sw.B: Shika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ukiishi kwa kufuata njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kumcha kwa heshima.
sw.R: Basi zitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Ishi jinsi anavyotaka uishi, na umheshimu kwa moyo wote.

decisions.choice: walk in his ways: live the way God directs
decisions.reason: "Walking" is the Hebrew picture for how one lives; God's "ways" are the kind of life he commands (5:33; 10:12; 11:22).

decisions.choice: fear him: reverent awe that leads to obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD in Deuteronomy is to honor him as God with awe, and so to obey and serve him (6:2, 13, 24; 10:12, 20). It is not terror but reverence.

decisions.choice: live the way he wants you to live; honor him with deep respect
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two pictures in plain words: "ways" as a way of living, and "fear" as reverent respect (m2).

source.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh your God [is] bringing you into a good land, a land of streams of water, springs and deeps going out in the valley and in the mountain;

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of streams of water, of springs and deep waters going out in the valley and in the hill country,
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is bringing you into a good land, a land with flowing streams, with springs and underground waters that pour out in the valleys and the hills,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is bringing you into a good land. It has many streams. Springs and water from deep under the ground flow out in its valleys and hills.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te introduce en una tierra buena, tierra de arroyos de agua, de manantiales y aguas profundas que brotan en el valle y en la montaña,
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te lleva a una tierra buena, una tierra de arroyos que corren, de manantiales y aguas subterráneas que brotan en los valles y en los montes,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te lleva a una tierra buena. Tiene muchos arroyos. En sus valles y en sus colinas brotan manantiales y agua de debajo de la tierra.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te fait entrer dans un bon pays, un pays de cours d’eau, de sources et d’eaux profondes qui jaillissent dans la vallée et dans la montagne,
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te conduit vers un bon pays, un pays de ruisseaux qui coulent, de sources et d’eaux souterraines qui jaillissent dans les vallées et sur les collines,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te conduit dans un bon pays. Il y a beaucoup de ruisseaux. Dans ses vallées et ses collines, des sources et de l’eau venue du fond de la terre sortent du sol.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakuingiza katika nchi nzuri, nchi ya vijito vya maji, ya chemchemi na vilindi vinavyobubujika bondeni na mlimani,
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakuingiza katika nchi nzuri, nchi yenye vijito vinavyotiririka, yenye chemchemi na maji ya chini ya ardhi yanayobubujika katika mabonde na vilima,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakuingiza katika nchi nzuri. Ina vijito vingi. Chemchemi na maji kutoka chini kabisa ya ardhi hububujika katika mabonde na vilima vyake.

decisions.choice: streams of water: valleys with running water
decisions.reason: The word names a stream or the valley it runs in, often a watercourse that flows in the rainy season. "Of water" stresses that these flow.

decisions.choice: deeps: waters deep under the ground
decisions.reason: It is the same word as "the deep" in Genesis 1:2 and 7:11. Here it means the underground waters that come up as springs.

decisions.choice: the valley and the mountain: valleys and hills in general
decisions.reason: The singular nouns with the article name kinds of country, as in "in the hill country". The land has water both in its low places and its high places, unlike Egypt, which depends on watering by hand from the Nile (11:10-11).

decisions.choice: for: the reason to keep the commandments (verse 6)
decisions.reason: The good land the LORD is giving is the ground of the call to obey him. The description runs on through verse 9.

decisions.choice: underground waters; valleys and hills
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain "deeps" and use plurals for the collective singulars. Literal keeps "deep waters", "the valley" and "the hill country".

source.text: אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ־זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: a land of wheat and barley and vine and fig tree and pomegranate, a land of olive [of] oil and honey,

en.L: a land of wheat and barley, and vine and fig tree and pomegranate, a land of olive trees for oil, and honey,
en.B: a land of wheat and barley, of vines, fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey,
en.R: It is a land of wheat and barley, of grapevines, fig trees and pomegranates. It is a land of olive oil and honey.

es.L: tierra de trigo y cebada, y de vid e higuera y granado, tierra de olivo de aceite, y de miel,
es.B: una tierra de trigo y cebada, de vides, higueras y granados, una tierra de aceite de oliva y miel,
es.R: Es una tierra de trigo y cebada, de viñas, higueras y granados. Es una tierra de aceite de oliva y de miel.

fr.L: un pays de blé et d’orge, et de vigne et de figuier et de grenadier, un pays d’oliviers à huile, et de miel,
fr.B: un pays de blé et d’orge, de vignes, de figuiers et de grenadiers, un pays d’huile d’olive et de miel,
fr.R: C’est un pays de blé et d’orge, de vignes, de figuiers et de grenadiers. C’est un pays d’huile d’olive et de miel.

sw.L: nchi ya ngano na shayiri, na mizabibu na mitini na mikomamanga, nchi ya mizeituni ya mafuta, na asali,
sw.B: nchi ya ngano na shayiri, ya mizabibu, mitini na mikomamanga, nchi ya mafuta ya zeituni na asali,
sw.R: Ni nchi ya ngano na shayiri, ya mizabibu, mitini na mikomamanga. Ni nchi ya mafuta ya zeituni na asali.

decisions.choice: the seven kinds: the land's chief crops
decisions.reason: Wheat, barley, grapes, figs, pomegranates, olives and honey make a list of seven, the main foods of the land of Israel. Spies had brought back grapes, pomegranates and figs (Numbers 13:23).

decisions.choice: olive of oil: olive trees grown for their oil
decisions.reason: The phrase names olives of the kind pressed for oil, the land's main source of oil for food, lamps and anointing.

decisions.choice: honey: sweet syrup
decisions.reason: The word is used of bees' honey (Judges 14:8) and also of thick syrup from fruit such as dates or grapes. Next to the crops of this list, fruit syrup may be meant, but the word covers both.

decisions.choice: olive oil
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "olive oil" for "olive of oil". Literal shows the Hebrew pairing.

source.text: אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל־בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא־תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: a land in which not in scarcity you will eat in it bread, not you will lack anything in it; a land whose stones [are] iron and from its hills you will dig copper.

en.L: a land where you will not eat bread in poverty; you will not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and from its hills you will dig copper.
en.B: a land where you will eat food without shortage and lack nothing, a land whose rocks hold iron and from whose hills you can dig copper.
en.R: There you will have plenty of food to eat, and you will not be in need of anything. Its rocks have iron in them, and you can dig copper out of its hills.

es.L: tierra en la que no comerás el pan con escasez; no te faltará nada en ella; tierra cuyas piedras [son] hierro, y de cuyos montes sacarás cobre.
es.B: una tierra donde comerás sin escasez y no te faltará nada, una tierra cuyas rocas contienen hierro y de cuyas colinas podrás extraer cobre.
es.R: Allí tendrás comida en abundancia, y no te faltará nada. Sus rocas tienen hierro, y de sus colinas podrás sacar cobre.

fr.L: un pays où tu ne mangeras pas le pain dans la pénurie ; tu n’y manqueras de rien ; un pays dont les pierres [sont] du fer, et de ses collines tu extrairas du cuivre.
fr.B: un pays où tu mangeras sans manquer de nourriture et où rien ne te fera défaut, un pays dont les roches contiennent du fer et dont tu pourras extraire le cuivre des collines.
fr.R: Là, tu auras de la nourriture en abondance, et tu ne manqueras de rien. Ses roches contiennent du fer, et tu pourras tirer du cuivre de ses collines.

sw.L: nchi ambayo hutakula mkate kwa uhaba; hutakosa kitu chochote ndani yake; nchi ambayo mawe yake [ni] chuma, na kutoka milimani mwake utachimba shaba.
sw.B: nchi ambayo utakula chakula bila upungufu wala kukosa kitu, nchi ambayo miamba yake ina chuma na kutoka vilima vyake unaweza kuchimba shaba.
sw.R: Huko utakuwa na chakula tele, wala hutapungukiwa na kitu. Miamba yake ina chuma, na unaweza kuchimba shaba kutoka vilima vyake.

decisions.choice: bread: food
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the word stands for food in general. "Not in poverty" means without want: there will be enough.

decisions.choice: its stones are iron: its rocks contain iron ore
decisions.reason: The land has iron in its rocks, which could be dug and smelted. It is a way of saying the land is rich even in its stones.

decisions.choice: copper: the ore from which bronze was made
decisions.reason: The word names copper and also bronze, the alloy of copper and tin. One dug copper ore, not bronze. Copper was mined in ancient times in the Arabah, the rift valley south of the Dead Sea, on the borders of the land.

decisions.choice: food
decisions.reason: Balanced says "food" for "bread" here, where the point is plenty of everything to eat. In verse 3 it keeps "bread" because Jesus' quotation of that verse made it familiar.

source.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will eat and be satisfied, and you will bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given to you.

en.L: And you will eat and be satisfied, and you will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for the good land which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given to you.
en.B: When you have eaten and are full, you are to bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for the good land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given you.
en.R: When you have eaten all you want, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for the good land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given you.

es.L: Y comerás y te saciarás, y bendecirás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios por la buena tierra que te ha dado.
es.B: Cuando hayas comido y estés satisfecho, bendecirás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios por la buena tierra que te ha dado.
es.R: Cuando hayas comido todo lo que quieras, alaba {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y dale gracias por la buena tierra que te ha dado.

fr.L: Et tu mangeras et tu seras rassasié, et tu béniras {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour le bon pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donné.
fr.B: Quand tu auras mangé et seras rassasié, tu béniras {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour le bon pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donné.
fr.R: Quand tu auras mangé tout ce que tu veux, loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu et remercie-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pour le bon pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donné.

sw.L: Nawe utakula na kushiba, na kumhimidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa ajili ya nchi nzuri aliyokupa.
sw.B: Ukisha kula na kushiba, utamhimidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa ajili ya nchi nzuri aliyokupa.
sw.R: Ukisha kula na kushiba, msifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kumshukuru kwa ajili ya nchi nzuri aliyokupa.

decisions.choice: you shall bless: what Israel is to do once it is fed
decisions.reason: The verb forms run on from the promise of the land: you will eat, be satisfied, and bless. The last is a duty as much as a prediction, the right answer to God's gifts, and verses 11-18 warn against the opposite.

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise and thank him
decisions.reason: When people bless God they do not give him anything; they speak well of him, praising and thanking him for what he has done.

decisions.choice: the basis of giving thanks after a meal
decisions.reason: In Jewish practice this verse became the basis for the blessing said after meals, which thanks God for food and for the land.

decisions.choice: praise ... and thank him
decisions.reason: Readable uses two plain verbs for "bless" with God as its object (m2).

source.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Take care for yourself lest you forget Yahweh your God by not keeping his commandments and his judgments and his statutes which I [am] commanding you today,

en.L: Take care for yourself, lest you forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God by not keeping {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, which I am commanding you today,
en.B: Be on your guard against forgetting {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God by neglecting {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rulings and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes that I am giving you today,
en.R: Be careful not to forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Do not stop obeying {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands, rules and laws that I am giving you today.

es.L: Guárdate a ti mismo, no sea que olvides {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios dejando de guardar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} juicios y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos que yo te mando hoy,
es.B: Ten cuidado de no olvidar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios descuidando {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos que hoy te doy,
es.R: Ten cuidado de no olvidarte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. No dejes de obedecer {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes que hoy te doy.

fr.L: Prends garde à toi, de peur que tu n’oublies {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu en ne gardant pas {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, que je te commande aujourd’hui,
fr.B: Garde-toi d’oublier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu en négligeant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} règles et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions que je te donne aujourd’hui,
fr.R: Fais attention à ne pas oublier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Ne cesse pas d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} règles et à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois que je te donne aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Jihadhari nafsi yako, usije ukamsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa kutozishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, ninazokuamuru leo,
sw.B: Jihadhari usimsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa kupuuza amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokupa leo,
sw.R: Kuwa mwangalifu usimsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Usiache kutii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokupa leo.

decisions.choice: forget the LORD by not keeping his commandments: forgetting shown in neglect
decisions.reason: To forget God here is not a lapse of memory but a turning away from him, and it shows itself in not keeping what he commands. Verses 12-17 describe how plenty can lead to it; 6:12 gave the same warning.

decisions.choice: commandments, judgments and statutes: the whole of God's law
decisions.reason: The three words together stand for everything Moses is teaching, as in 5:31, 6:1 and 7:11. Commandments are what God orders, judgments are rulings for justice in cases, and statutes are fixed laws.

decisions.choice: take care for yourself: watch yourself, be on guard
decisions.reason: The verb is "guard" or "keep" in a form that turns it back on the speaker's hearers: guard yourself. The same verb gives "keeping" later in the verse.

decisions.choice: commandments, judgments, statutes (Literal); commandments, rulings, statutes (Balanced); commands, rules, laws (Readable)
decisions.reason: These are the project's settled words for the three terms in Numbers to Ruth, kept the same in every chapter.

source.text: פֶּן־תֹּאכַ֖ל וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבָתִּ֥ים טוֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: lest you eat and are satisfied, and good houses you build and dwell,

en.L: lest you eat and are satisfied, and build good houses and live [in them],
en.B: otherwise, when you have eaten your fill and have built fine houses and live in them,
en.R: You will eat all you want. You will build fine houses and live in them.

es.L: no sea que comas y te sacies, y edifiques buenas casas y [las] habites,
es.B: no sea que, cuando hayas comido hasta saciarte y hayas construido hermosas casas y vivas en ellas,
es.R: Comerás todo lo que quieras. Construirás buenas casas y vivirás en ellas.

fr.L: de peur que tu ne manges et ne sois rassasié, et que tu ne bâtisses de bonnes maisons et [n’y] habites,
fr.B: sinon, quand tu auras mangé à satiété, que tu auras bâti de belles maisons et que tu y habiteras,
fr.R: Tu mangeras tout ce que tu voudras. Tu construiras de belles maisons et tu y habiteras.

sw.L: usije ukala na kushiba, na kujenga nyumba nzuri na kukaa [ndani yake],
sw.B: la sivyo, utakapokuwa umekula na kushiba, na kujenga nyumba nzuri na kuishi ndani yake,
sw.R: Utakula kadiri unavyotaka. Utajenga nyumba nzuri na kuishi ndani yake.

decisions.choice: lest: the warning runs through verse 17
decisions.reason: The word "lest" repeats the warning of verse 11 and governs everything up to verse 17: when you have plenty, take care that your heart does not grow proud and forget the LORD.

decisions.choice: good houses: well-built, fine houses
decisions.reason: After forty years in tents, settled life in solid houses is a sign of the land's wealth (6:10-11).

decisions.choice: the warning moves to verse 14
decisions.reason: Readable states the coming plenty as plain facts in verses 12-13 and gives the warning ("lest") in verse 14, "When that happens, do not ...", to keep its sentences short.

source.text: וּבְקָֽרְךָ֤ וְצֹֽאנְךָ֙ יִרְבְּיֻ֔ן וְכֶ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה־לָּ֑ךְ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and your herd and your flock multiply, and silver and gold increase for you, and all that [is] to you increases,

en.L: and your herd and your flock multiply, and silver and gold increase for you, and all that you have increases,
en.B: and when your herds and flocks grow large, and your silver and gold increase, and everything you own multiplies,
en.R: Your herds and flocks will grow large. You will have more and more silver and gold, and more of everything you own.

es.L: y tus vacas y tus ovejas se multipliquen, y la plata y el oro se te aumenten, y todo lo que tienes se aumente,
es.B: y cuando tus manadas y rebaños crezcan, y aumenten tu plata y tu oro, y se multiplique todo lo que posees,
es.R: Tus manadas y tus rebaños crecerán. Tendrás cada vez más plata y oro, y más de todo lo que posees.

fr.L: et que ton gros bétail et ton petit bétail ne se multiplient, que l’argent et l’or n’augmentent pour toi, et que tout ce qui est à toi n’augmente,
fr.B: que tes troupeaux de bœufs et de moutons se seront accrus, que ton argent et ton or auront augmenté et que tous tes biens se seront multipliés,
fr.R: Tes troupeaux deviendront grands. Tu auras de plus en plus d’argent et d’or, et de plus en plus de tout ce que tu possèdes.

sw.L: na ng'ombe wako na kondoo wako wakaongezeka, na fedha na dhahabu zikakuongezekea, na vyote ulivyo navyo vikaongezeka,
sw.B: na makundi yako ya ng'ombe na kondoo yatakapoongezeka, na fedha na dhahabu yako ikaongezeka, na kila kitu ulicho nacho kikazidi,
sw.R: Makundi yako ya ng'ombe na kondoo yataongezeka. Utakuwa na fedha na dhahabu zaidi na zaidi, na zaidi ya kila kitu ulicho nacho.

decisions.choice: herd and flock: cattle, and sheep and goats
decisions.reason: The first word means cattle; the second means small livestock, sheep and goats together. Singular in Hebrew, each names a whole group of animals.

decisions.choice: multiply, increase: the same verb three times
decisions.reason: The verb "become many" is repeated for herds, money and everything else, and it was used of the people themselves in verse 1. The growth God promised can become the reason to forget him.

source.text: וְרָ֖ם לְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and lifted up [is] your heart and you forget Yahweh your God, the [one] bringing you out from [the] land of Egypt, from [the] house of slaves,

en.L: and your heart is lifted up, and you forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves,
en.B: your heart may grow proud and you may forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery,
en.R: When that happens, do not become proud and forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. He brought you out of Egypt, where you were slaves.

es.L: y se enaltezca tu corazón y olvides {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, que te sacó de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de esclavos,
es.B: tu corazón se ensoberbezca y te olvides {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, que te sacó de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de esclavitud,
es.R: Cuando eso pase, no te vuelvas orgulloso ni te olvides {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Él te sacó de Egipto, donde eras esclavo.

fr.L: et que ton cœur ne s’élève, et que tu n’oublies {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, qui t’a fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, de la maison des esclaves,
fr.B: ton cœur pourrait s’enorgueillir et tu pourrais oublier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, qui t’a fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, de la maison d’esclavage,
fr.R: Quand cela arrivera, ne deviens pas orgueilleux et n’oublie pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui t’a fait sortir d’Égypte, où tu étais esclave.

sw.L: na moyo wako ukainuka, ukamsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, aliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, katika nyumba ya watumwa,
sw.B: moyo wako unaweza kujivuna, ukamsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, aliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, katika nyumba ya utumwa,
sw.R: Hayo yakitokea, usijivune na kumsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Yeye ndiye aliyekutoa Misri, ulikokuwa mtumwa.

decisions.choice: your heart is lifted up: you become proud
decisions.reason: A heart raised high is a proud, self-important heart (17:20). Hosea 13:6 tells the same story: the people were fed, were satisfied, their heart was lifted up, and they forgot God.

decisions.choice: the house of slaves: Egypt as the place of slavery
decisions.reason: Egypt is called the house of slaves, where Israel lived in bondage (5:6; 6:12; Exodus 20:2). Remembering it keeps Israel humble.

decisions.choice: who brought you out: the first of a chain of descriptions of the LORD
decisions.reason: Three phrases follow, "who brought you out", "who led you" (verse 15) and "who fed you" (verse 16), each beginning in Hebrew with "the one who". They recall what God did, which pride forgets.

decisions.choice: slaves / slavery
decisions.reason: Israel's slavery in Egypt is a place where "slave" stays at every level (the style guide's rule for this word), since it is slavery itself that God freed them from.

decisions.choice: may grow proud ... may forget
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "may" to carry the "lest" of verse 12 across these records: this is a danger, not a prediction.

source.text: הַמּוֹלִ֨יכֲךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר׀הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ׀שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־מָ֑יִם הַמּוֹצִ֤יא לְךָ֙ מַ֔יִם מִצּ֖וּר הַֽחַלָּמִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: the [one] leading you in the wilderness, the great and the terrible, snake fiery and scorpion and thirsty ground where there [was] no water, the [one] bringing out for you water from [the] rock of flint,

en.L: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, [with] fiery snake and scorpion and thirsty ground where there was no water, who brought out water for you from the flint rock,
en.B: who guided you through that vast and dreadful wilderness, a land of fiery snakes and scorpions, of parched ground without water, who made water come out of flint rock for you,
en.R: He led you through the huge and frightening desert. It had fiery, poisonous snakes and scorpions. The ground was dry, and there was no water. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made water flow out of hard rock for you.

es.L: que te condujo por el desierto grande y terrible, [con] serpiente ardiente y escorpión, y tierra sedienta donde no había agua; que sacó para ti agua de la roca de pedernal,
es.B: que te guió por aquel desierto inmenso y temible, tierra de serpientes ardientes y escorpiones, de suelo reseco sin agua; que hizo brotar para ti agua de la roca de pedernal,
es.R: Él te guió por el desierto, enorme y espantoso. Había serpientes ardientes y venenosas, y escorpiones. La tierra estaba seca, y no había agua. Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo que saliera agua de la roca dura para ti.

fr.L: qui t’a conduit dans le désert grand et terrible, [avec] serpent brûlant et scorpion, et sol assoiffé où il n’y avait pas d’eau, qui a fait sortir pour toi de l’eau du rocher de silex,
fr.B: qui t’a guidé à travers ce désert immense et redoutable, pays de serpents brûlants et de scorpions, terre desséchée et sans eau, qui a fait jaillir pour toi l’eau du rocher de silex,
fr.R: Il t’a conduit à travers ce désert immense et effrayant. Il y avait des serpents brûlants et venimeux, et des scorpions. Le sol était sec, et il n’y avait pas d’eau. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait couler pour toi de l’eau d’un rocher dur.

sw.L: aliyekuongoza katika nyika ile kubwa na ya kutisha, [yenye] nyoka wa moto na nge na ardhi yenye kiu isiyo na maji, aliyekutolea maji kutoka katika mwamba wa gumegume,
sw.B: aliyekuongoza katika nyika ile pana na ya kuogofya, nchi ya nyoka wa moto na nge, ya ardhi kame isiyo na maji, aliyekutolea maji kutoka katika mwamba mgumu wa gumegume,
sw.R: Alikuongoza katika jangwa kubwa na la kutisha. Lilikuwa na nyoka wa moto wenye sumu na nge. Ardhi ilikuwa kavu, na hapakuwa na maji. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alikutolea maji kutoka katika mwamba mgumu.

decisions.choice: fiery snake: a snake whose bite burns
decisions.reason: The word "fiery" is from the verb "burn". It is used of the snakes in Numbers 21:6, and probably describes the burning pain of their venom, though it may describe their color.

decisions.choice: terrible: fearsome, causing dread
decisions.reason: The word means to be feared. The wilderness was a place of danger to life (1:19).

decisions.choice: water from the rock: the springs God gave at Rephidim and Kadesh
decisions.reason: God brought water from a rock in Exodus 17:6 and Numbers 20:11. Flint is the hardest of stones, so the water was plainly his gift (32:13; Psalm 114:8).

decisions.choice: thirsty ground: dry, parched land
decisions.reason: The word names land that is thirsty, without water, as the next words say.

decisions.choice: fiery, poisonous snakes; desert
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "fiery" and adds "poisonous", as Readable does in Numbers 21:6, and says "desert" for this dry wilderness. "But" marks the contrast between the dry land and the water God gave.

source.text: הַמַּֽאֲכִ֨לְךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֗ וּלְמַ֨עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔ךָ לְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: the [one] feeding you manna in the wilderness which not had known your fathers, so as to humble you and so as to test you, to do you good in your end,

en.L: who fed you manna in the wilderness, which your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and in order to test you, to do you good at your end,
en.B: who gave you manna to eat in the wilderness, a food unknown to your ancestors, so as to humble you and test you and in the end to bring you good,
en.R: In the desert {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fed you with manna, a food your ancestors had never known. He did this to humble you and test you, so that in the end {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could do good things for you.

es.L: que te alimentó con maná en el desierto, el cual no habían conocido tus padres, para humillarte y para probarte, para hacerte bien a tu final,
es.B: que en el desierto te dio a comer maná, un alimento desconocido para tus antepasados, para humillarte y probarte y, al final, hacerte bien,
es.R: En el desierto {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te alimentó con maná, una comida que tus antepasados nunca habían conocido. Lo hizo para hacerte humilde y ponerte a prueba, y así al final poder hacerte bien.

fr.L: qui t’a nourri de manne dans le désert, [manne] que tes pères n’avaient pas connue, afin de t’humilier et afin de t’éprouver, pour te faire du bien à ta fin,
fr.B: qui t’a donné à manger dans le désert la manne, une nourriture inconnue de tes ancêtres, pour t’humilier et t’éprouver, et pour te faire du bien à la fin,
fr.R: Dans le désert, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a nourri de manne, une nourriture que tes ancêtres n’avaient jamais connue. Il l’a fait pour te rendre humble et te mettre à l’épreuve, afin de pouvoir te faire du bien à la fin.

sw.L: aliyekulisha mana nyikani, ambayo baba zako hawakuijua, ili akunyenyekeze na ili akujaribu, akutendee mema mwisho wako,
sw.B: aliyekulisha mana nyikani, chakula ambacho mababu zako hawakukijua, ili akunyenyekeze na kukujaribu, na mwishowe akutendee mema,
sw.R: Huko jangwani alikulisha mana, chakula ambacho mababu zako hawakuwahi kukijua. Alifanya hivyo ili akunyenyekeze na kukujaribu, ili mwishowe {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akutendee mambo mema.

decisions.choice: to do you good in your end: so that afterward it would go well with you
decisions.reason: "Your end" means what comes after, your later days, not your death. The hard years of humbling and testing (verses 2-3) had a good purpose for the people's future in the land.

decisions.choice: humbling and testing for Israel's good
decisions.reason: The verse picks up verses 2-3: the hardship of the wilderness was God's training, like a father's discipline (verse 5), and it was meant to end in blessing.

decisions.choice: he could do good things for you
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who does good, which the Hebrew implies by making the whole chain of phrases describe him.

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ כֹּחִי֙ וְעֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֶת־הַחַ֥יִל הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and you say in your heart, my strength and [the] might of my hand made for me this wealth.

en.L: and you say in your heart, 'My strength and the might of my hand have made this wealth for me.'
en.B: and you may say to yourself, 'My own power and the strength of my own hands have won me this wealth.'
en.R: Do not think to yourself, 'I got all this wealth by my own power and strength.'

es.L: y digas en tu corazón: “Mi fuerza y el poder de mi mano me han hecho esta riqueza.”
es.B: y llegues a decirte: “Mi propio poder y la fuerza de mis propias manos me han conseguido esta riqueza.”
es.R: No pienses: “Conseguí toda esta riqueza con mi propio poder y mi propia fuerza.”

fr.L: et que tu ne dises dans ton cœur : “Ma force et la puissance de ma main m’ont acquis cette richesse.”
fr.B: et que tu ne te dises : “C’est ma propre force et la vigueur de mes propres mains qui m’ont valu cette richesse.”
fr.R: Ne pense pas : “J’ai gagné toute cette richesse par ma propre puissance et ma propre force.”

sw.L: nawe ukasema moyoni mwako, 'Nguvu zangu na uwezo wa mkono wangu ndivyo vilivyonipatia utajiri huu.'
sw.B: ukajisemea, 'Uwezo wangu mwenyewe na nguvu za mikono yangu mwenyewe ndivyo vilivyonipatia mali hii.'
sw.R: Usifikiri moyoni, 'Nimepata utajiri huu wote kwa uwezo na nguvu zangu mwenyewe.'

decisions.choice: say in your heart: think to yourself
decisions.reason: To say something in the heart is to think it without saying it aloud (7:17; 9:4).

decisions.choice: made wealth: gained wealth
decisions.reason: The verb "make" with "wealth" means to acquire it (Genesis 12:5; 31:1). The noun means strength and ability as well as wealth; verse 18 answers that the strength comes from God.

decisions.choice: the might of my hand: my own ability
decisions.reason: The hand stands for a person's power to act. The boast puts self in the place God holds in verses 14-16, where his hand freed and fed the people.

decisions.choice: Do not think
decisions.reason: Readable makes this the last part of the warning begun in verse 14, "do not ...", which the Hebrew "lest" of verse 12 carries.

source.text: וְזָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת־בְּרִית֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you shall remember Yahweh your God, for he [is] the [one] giving you strength to make wealth, so as to establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as [at] this day.

en.L: And you shall remember {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the one giving you strength to make wealth, in order to establish {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to your fathers, as [at] this day.
en.B: Remember {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God instead. It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who gives you the ability to grow wealthy, in order to carry out the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to your ancestors, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is doing today.
en.R: Instead, remember {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. He is the one who gives you the strength to become rich. He does this to keep the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised with an oath to your ancestors, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is doing today.

es.L: Y te acordarás {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el que te da fuerza para hacer riqueza, a fin de confirmar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto que juró a tus padres, como [en] este día.
es.B: Acuérdate más bien {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien te da la capacidad de enriquecerte, para cumplir el pacto que juró a tus antepasados, como lo está haciendo hoy.
es.R: Al contrario, acuérdate {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Él es quien te da las fuerzas para hacerte rico. Lo hace para cumplir el pacto que prometió con juramento a tus antepasados, como lo está haciendo hoy.

fr.L: Et tu te souviendras {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui te donne la force d’acquérir la richesse, afin d’établir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a jurée à tes pères, comme [en] ce jour.
fr.B: Souviens-toi plutôt {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui te donne le pouvoir de t’enrichir, pour accomplir l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a jurée à tes ancêtres, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Au contraire, souviens-toi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui te donne la force de devenir riche. Il le fait pour tenir l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promise par serment à tes ancêtres, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Nawe utamkumbuka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] anayekupa nguvu za kupata utajiri, ili alithibitishe agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alilowaapia baba zako, kama [ilivyo] siku hii.
sw.B: Badala yake mkumbuke {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayekupa uwezo wa kupata mali, ili alitimize agano alilowaapia mababu zako, kama anavyofanya leo.
sw.R: Badala yake, mkumbuke {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Yeye ndiye anayekupa nguvu za kuwa tajiri. Anafanya hivyo ili kulishika agano alilowaahidi mababu zako kwa kiapo, kama anavyofanya leo.

decisions.choice: strength to make wealth: the ability to gain wealth
decisions.reason: This answers the boast of verse 17 word for word: the strength and the wealth are both God's gift. The same verb and noun are used.

decisions.choice: establish his covenant: keep and carry out his covenant
decisions.reason: To "raise up" or establish a covenant is to make it stand, to do what it promised (Genesis 17:7; 26:3). Israel's wealth in the land is God keeping his word to the ancestors, not Israel's achievement.

decisions.choice: as this day: as you see it now
decisions.reason: The phrase means "as is the case today" or "as it is now happening". God's faithfulness can already be seen in what he has done.

decisions.choice: instead
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "instead" for the plain "and", because this is the opposite of the boast in verse 17. Literal keeps "And".

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתָּ֖ם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, if forgetting you forget Yahweh your God and walk after other gods and serve them and bow down to them, I testify against you today that perishing you will perish.

en.L: And it shall be, if you indeed forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and walk after other gods and serve them and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
en.B: If you ever do forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and follow other gods, serving them and bowing down to them, I declare to you today, as a witness, that you will certainly perish.
en.R: If you ever forget {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and follow other gods, if you serve them and bow down to worship them, I am warning you today: you will certainly be destroyed.

es.L: Y será que, si de cierto olvidas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y andas tras otros dioses y les sirves y te inclinas ante ellos, yo testifico hoy contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que de cierto {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}}.
es.B: Si alguna vez llegas a olvidarte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y sigues a otros dioses, sirviéndoles e inclinándote ante ellos, hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} declaro, como testigo, que sin duda {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}}.
es.R: Si alguna vez te olvidas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y sigues a otros dioses, si les sirves y te inclinas para adorarlos, hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} advierto: sin duda {{plural_you:serán destruidos|seréis destruidos}}.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, si vraiment tu oublies {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et si tu marches derrière d’autres dieux, et les sers, et te prosternes devant eux, je témoigne contre vous aujourd’hui que vous périrez certainement.
fr.B: Si jamais tu oublies {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu et que tu suis d’autres dieux, que tu les sers et te prosternes devant eux, je vous le déclare aujourd’hui, et j’en suis témoin : vous périrez, c’est certain.
fr.R: Si jamais tu oublies {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu et que tu suis d’autres dieux, si tu les sers et te prosternes devant eux pour les adorer, je vous avertis aujourd’hui : vous serez détruits, c’est sûr.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, ikiwa hakika utamsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na kuifuata miungu mingine, na kuitumikia na kuisujudia, ninashuhudia juu yenu leo kwamba hakika mtaangamia.
sw.B: Ukija kumsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuifuata miungu mingine, ukiitumikia na kuisujudia, ninawatangazia leo, nikiwa shahidi, kwamba hakika mtaangamia.
sw.R: Ukija kumsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuifuata miungu mingine, ukiitumikia na kuisujudia ili kuiabudu, ninawaonya leo: hakika mtaangamizwa.

decisions.choice: forgetting you forget, perishing you will perish: emphasis
decisions.reason: Hebrew doubles each verb for strength. The first stresses a real and complete forgetting; the second makes the outcome certain.

decisions.choice: walk after other gods: follow them as their servants
decisions.reason: To walk after someone is to follow and serve them (6:14; 11:28). Serving and bowing down are the acts of worship that follow.

decisions.choice: I testify against you: I call this as a solemn witness
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for a witness. Moses gives warning as a witness does in court, so that no one can later say they were not told (4:26; 30:19).

decisions.choice: you (plural) again
decisions.reason: Moses returns here to "you" plural, as in verse 1, and keeps it through verse 20 (see verse 1, m2).

decisions.choice: I declare to you today, as a witness / I am warning you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "testify against" in everyday words. Literal keeps "testify".

records.literal_gloss: Like the nations which Yahweh [is] destroying from before you, so you will perish, because not you would listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God.

en.L: Like the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is destroying from before you, so you will perish, because you would not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Like the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is destroying ahead of you, so you will perish, because you would not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is destroying the nations in front of you. You will be destroyed just like them, because you would not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Como las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} destruye delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, así {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}}, porque no {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}} la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: Igual que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va destruyendo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, así {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}}, por no haber obedecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está destruyendo a las naciones que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} delante. {{plural_you:Ustedes serán destruidos|Vosotros seréis destruidos}} igual que ellas, porque no {{plural_you:obedecieron|obedecisteis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.

fr.L: Comme les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait périr devant vous, ainsi vous périrez, parce que vous n’aurez pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Comme les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} détruit devant vous, ainsi vous périrez, pour n’avoir pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est en train de détruire les nations devant vous. Vous serez détruits comme elles, parce que vous n’aurez pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

sw.L: Kama mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayaangamiza mbele yenu, ndivyo mtakavyoangamia, kwa sababu hamkuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.B: Kama mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayaangamiza mbele yenu, ndivyo nanyi mtakavyoangamia, kwa sababu hamkumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayaangamiza mataifa yaliyo mbele yenu. Nanyi mtaangamizwa kama yalivyoangamizwa, kwa sababu hamkumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.

decisions.choice: listen to the voice: obey
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice in Hebrew is to heed and obey what they say (4:30; 13:5).

decisions.choice: like the nations: Israel is not exempt from judgment
decisions.reason: The nations of Canaan are losing their land because of their wickedness (9:4-5). If Israel lives as they did, it will share their fate (Leviticus 18:28). God's choice of Israel is no shield against disobedience.

decisions.choice: obey
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "obey" for the idiom (m1). Literal keeps "listen to the voice".
